0022600161.text: The New York Knicks (2-4, 11th in the East) host the Brooklyn Nets (1-5, 15th in the East) in the Knicks' seventh game of the season, with New York on a one-game losing streak and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, while Brooklyn has won its last game but is 0-3 at home. Jose Alvarado is out for New York with an ankle sprain, and Brooklyn will be without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 93-92 New York win in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026, while this season's series has no games yet.
